title: Fate's Twin
next_chapter_hook: When the two pages of the Tianji Record slowly approached each other in the void, the thrill that tore through fate made Chen Ji instantly understand—unity was not an ending, but the beginning of a greater chess game.

text.content: Morning mist draped like thin gauze over Luoyan Valley, with Chen Ji standing alone before the ancient inscribed boulder. The warmth lingering in his palm had long dissipated, yet last night's restless tossing remained vivid—the words 'tomorrow at noon' like a curse, surfacing each time he closed his eyes. He unconsciously stroked the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms, feeling the distinctive coarse texture of the paper, as if it were the only thing that could bring him peace.

The noon bell rang悠悠 from the distant Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji took a deep breath and ventured into the valley's depths according to the message Mo Xiansheng had sent last night. Each step landed on thick fallen leaves, producing soft rustling sounds. The surroundings were eerily silent, even the usually noisy mountain birds had fallen silent, as if the entire valley was holding its breath, waiting for some fateful moment to arrive.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) Mo Xiansheng said there's someone I must meet here... but why do I always feel that this person's appearance will completely change everything?

text.content: Passing through the final veil of mist, his vision opened up abruptly. Chen Ji saw—a man of identical height, features, even the subtle arcs between his brows, standing with hands clasped behind his back on a blue stone in the valley's center. The man wore the same gray servant disciple robe as him. Had he not witnessed it himself, Chen Ji would have thought he was looking into a mirror.

dialogue.content: (Pupils contracting sharply, voice tightening) Who... who are you?
(The man turned, a meaningful smile curving his lips) I am Chen Xuan—or rather, I am the other half of the Tianji Record, and you are the fate's twin I have been searching for整整 twenty years.

text.content: Chen Xuan walked over slowly, each step unhurried and composed. Chen Ji noticed in the other's eye reflections that same deep-seated calculation as his own. This discovery sent a chill down his spine—an alternate person in this world who could see through his disguise. He unconsciously tightened his fists, fingernails digging deep into his palms.

dialogue.content: (Chen Xuan stopped three feet away, gaze burning) No need to be nervous. If I wanted to harm you, I wouldn't choose this way to reveal myself. You should already sense—the Tianji Record Fragment in your body is resonating with mine.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes to sense, and indeed detected faint vibrations from the fragment in his arms, like heartbeats echoing some rhythm within him. His eyes snapped open, cold light flashing.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) Resonance? What are you implying—that we are the same person?

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan's words held hidden meanings. Chen Ji realized this might be a turning point that could change his fate. He needed to decide how to respond to this existence entangled with his destiny.

choices.text: Remain vigilant, probe the other's hand first
choices.description: Trust no one of unknown origin, especially when the person shares identical abilities with you. Keep your distance, observe the other's true intentions and strength first.
choices.visible_cost: May miss opportunity for deep cooperation
choices.visible_reward: Keep your cards hidden, avoid exposing weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: The other may possess more secrets of the Tianji Record

dialogue.content: (Stepping back half a pace, expression cold) Though we share the same face, we may not share the same heart. Before you prove your sincerity, why should I trust you?

choices.text: Open your heart, seek truth and cooperation
choices.description: Since the Tianji Record chose both of you for a reason, why not be candid? Perhaps you can obtain more information about the complete version of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock new abilities of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If the other harbors malicious intent, you will be completely defenseless

dialogue.content: (Taking a deep breath, lowering his guard) Fine, I'll trust you this once. But if you deceive me in any way... though I, Chen Ji, amtrash, I am no one to be manipulated.

choices.text: Strike first, eliminate the threat completely
choices.description: There can only be one master of destiny. Since the Tianji Record chose you, why keep a threat? Strike when the other is off guard.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance to learn the truth about the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate potential threat, exclusively possess the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The other's strength is unknown; both may be seriously injured

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned sharply cold. A short blade appeared in his hand out of nowhere, its cold light flashing as it thrust toward Chen Xuan's throat. This move was both swift and ruthless, nowhere near the身手 expected of atrash disciple.

Chen Xuan remained unmoving before Chen Ji's attack. As the cold light approached within three inches, he gently raised his right hand. An invisible barrier deflected the blade entirely. Chen Ji felt a jolt in his wrist, his entire arm going numb.

dialogue.content: (A flash of disappointment in Chen Xuan's eyes) You chose destruction? ...Well, that's also an answer. But have you considered—if I were truly an enemy, that strike alone would have taken your life. I'm here to tell you a truth.

text.content: Chen Xuan waved his hand. An image actually materialized in the void—the complete form of the Tianji Record. Two yellowed pages spun around each other like yin and yang fish, and deep within the image, a colossal eye stared coldly at all this.

dialogue.content: We are both pieces on the chessboard of the Heavenly Eye—but now, we can choose our own fate. Unite, and let the Tianji Record display its true power; or continue to be pitiful ants in that eye's gaze?

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Xuan's proposed fate choice, Chen Ji must make the final decision. This step will determine his future path—whether to break free from the chess game's control, or continue playing the role assigned by the Heavenly Eye.

choices.description: Accept the arrangement of fate's twin, fuse with Chen Xuan to gain the complete power of the Tianji Record. This means complete exposure under the Heavenly Eye's gaze, but may also gain capital for counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: Complete version of Tianji Record, unlock six-hour prophecy ability
choices.risk_hint: The unity process is irreversible; may lose yourself

dialogue.content: (Silent for a long while, finally nodding) Very well. Since Heaven plays games with us, let it see that pieces can also overturn the chessboard.

choices.description: Rely on no one. Even with an incomplete Tianji Record, resist the Heavenly Eye through your own strength. This is a harder path, but means preserving your complete self.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the complete power of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Facing the Heavenly Eye alone will be far more perilous

dialogue.content: (Stepping back, gaze firm) Thank you for the information, but I, Chen Ji, never place hope in others. You take your broad road, I'll cross my narrow bridge. The Heavenly Eye... I will personally sever its gaze.

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Xuan did not become angry. Instead, he threw his head back in long laughter. That laughter echoed through the valley, startling a flock of birds, yet carried an inexplicable bleakness.

dialogue.content: (The smile fading, gaze profound) Good, very good. This is exactly what I was waiting for. The Heavenly Eye will not spare any piece that dares to resist—you and I are no exception. In that case... until we meet again.

text.content: Before the words even finished, Chen Xuan's figure dissolved like morning mist in the sunlight, leaving only Chen Ji standing alone in the valley's depths. The Tianji Record Fragment in his arms vibrated intensely, as if responding to that collision of fates.

dialogue.content: (Caressing the fragment, murmuring softly) The Heavenly Eye... what exactly are you? And Chen Xuan, why would you help me?... I remember this. When the time comes, all answers will reveal themselves.

text.content: When the two pages of the Tianji Record slowly approached each other in the void, the thrill that tore through fate made Chen Ji instantly understand—unity was not an ending, but the beginning of a greater chess game.
